description: Entity-resolution cases whose outcome rests on name similarity: near-miss spellings, clipped forms, acronyms, and similar-but-distinct names. Each case is one mention resolved against a small same-type candidate set. gold is the candidate id the mention refers to, or "new" when it is a different entity (including when the evidence cannot tell candidates apart). Used by scripts/eval_resolver_tiebreak.py.
provenance: Synthetic. Names are invented or generic; labels authored alongside the tiebreak implementation (2026-09-24) and not yet independently reviewed, so treat scores as a smoke test, not a benchmark.
